text: The gate SHALL open each supplied page in headless Chromium at the caller-specified viewport size and capture a full-page screenshot.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Page capture

text: When a page URL and a viewport size are supplied, open the page in headless Chromium at that viewport.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Page capture › Scenario: A page is captured › THEN[1]

text: When a page URL and a viewport size are supplied, capture a screenshot once the page has settled.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Page capture › Scenario: A page is captured › AND[2]

text: The gate SHALL wait for the network to be idle and for all web fonts to have finished loading before it captures a screenshot.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Readiness wait before capture

text: When the page has in-flight network requests or unloaded web fonts, wait until the network has been idle for 500 ms.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Readiness wait before capture › Scenario: A page is still loading resources › THEN[1]

text: When the page has in-flight network requests or unloaded web fonts, wait until `document.fonts.ready` has resolved.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Readiness wait before capture › Scenario: A page is still loading resources › AND[2]

text: When the page has in-flight network requests or unloaded web fonts, only then capture the screenshot.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Readiness wait before capture › Scenario: A page is still loading resources › AND[3]

text: The gate SHALL compare each captured screenshot to the stored baseline image for that page, pixel by pixel.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Baseline comparison

text: When a page has a stored baseline, compare the new screenshot to it pixel by pixel.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Baseline comparison › Scenario: A baseline exists for the page › THEN[1]

text: When a page has a stored baseline, compute the percentage of pixels that differ.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Baseline comparison › Scenario: A baseline exists for the page › AND[2]

text: The gate SHALL fail a page when more than 1% of its pixels differ from the baseline, and pass it otherwise.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Difference threshold

text: When 0.5% of a page's pixels differ from its baseline, pass the page.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Difference threshold › Scenario: A page has changed slightly › THEN[1]

text: When 3% of a page's pixels differ from its baseline, fail the page.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Difference threshold › Scenario: A page has changed substantially › THEN[1]

text: The gate SHALL exclude caller-specified regions, identified by CSS selector, from the comparison by masking them in both images first.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Masked regions

text: When the caller supplies CSS selectors for regions to ignore, fill those regions with a flat colour in both the baseline and the new screenshot.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Masked regions › Scenario: A page declares masked regions › THEN[1]

text: When the caller supplies CSS selectors for regions to ignore, compare the masked images.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Masked regions › Scenario: A page declares masked regions › AND[2]

text: The gate SHALL store the captured screenshot as the baseline and pass the page when no baseline yet exists for it.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: First run for a page

text: When a page has no stored baseline, save the current screenshot as that page's baseline.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: First run for a page › Scenario: A page is seen for the first time › THEN[1]

text: When a page has no stored baseline, report the page as passed.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: First run for a page › Scenario: A page is seen for the first time › AND[2]

text: The gate SHALL update a page's baseline automatically when the difference is below 2%, and SHALL otherwise require the caller to pass `--update-baselines`.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Baseline update policy

text: When a page differs from its baseline by less than 2%, replace the stored baseline with the new screenshot.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Baseline update policy › Scenario: A small change is detected › THEN[1]

text: When a page differs from its baseline by 2% or more, leave the baseline unchanged unless `--update-baselines` was passed.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Baseline update policy › Scenario: A large change is detected › THEN[1]

text: The gate SHALL capture every page at 2x device pixel ratio for retina fidelity.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Device pixel ratio

text: When a screenshot is taken, render the page at a device pixel ratio of 2.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Device pixel ratio › Scenario: A page is captured › THEN[1]

text: The gate SHALL produce an HTML report showing the baseline, current, and diff image for every page, side by side.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Report output

text: When every page has been compared, write an HTML report.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Report output › Scenario: A run completes › THEN[1]

text: When every page has been compared, include, per page, the baseline image, the current image, and a diff image.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Report output › Scenario: A run completes › AND[2]

text: The gate SHALL run an axe-core accessibility scan on every page and fail the page when a serious or critical violation is found.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Accessibility check

text: When axe-core reports a violation of impact `serious` or `critical`, fail the page.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Accessibility check › Scenario: A page has an accessibility violation › THEN[1]

text: When axe-core reports a violation of impact `serious` or `critical`, list the violation in the report.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Accessibility check › Scenario: A page has an accessibility violation › AND[2]

text: The gate SHALL additionally capture each page in headless Firefox and headless WebKit and compare each against a per-browser baseline.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Cross-browser capture

text: When a page is submitted for comparison, capture it in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Cross-browser capture › Scenario: A page is checked across browsers › THEN[1]

text: When a page is submitted for comparison, compare each capture against that browser's own baseline.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Cross-browser capture › Scenario: A page is checked across browsers › AND[2]
